summary.text: Royce Duplessis is a Democratic member of the Louisiana Senate, representing District 5 (Jefferson and Orleans parishes), and was elected in 2022, according to the official Senate member page.

paragraphs.text: It lists education as St. Augustine High School; Xavier University of Louisiana, B.S. in Communications; Howard University School of Law, Juris Doctorate.

The page lists committee assignments including Judiciary B, Natural Resources, Senate and Governmental Affairs, and the Senate Select Committee on Homeland Security, and caucus affiliations including the Democratic Caucus, the Jefferson Parish Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Orleans Delegation.
